## {{< fa laptop-code >}} Build the same package on your laptop

In the workshop I build the data package on my laptop. If you want to build the same package on yours while the live run goes on, install the following before the day. This is optional. Without it you still take part through the issue.

1.  R, version 4.4 or later, from <https://cran.r-project.org/>.
2.  An editor: [RStudio Desktop](https://posit.co/download/rstudio-desktop/) or [Positron](https://positron.posit.co/).
3.  The washr package. In the R console:

    ``` r
    install.packages("washr")
    ```

4.  Check that it loads without an error:

    ``` r
    library(washr)
    ```

The sample dataset and a step by step guide appear on this website on {{< meta cohort.guide_date >}}. The [washr documentation]({{< var tools.washr >}}) describes what the package does.
